q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The question asks about NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release. According to the research, NVIDIA is set to report on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close. Today is 2026-08-26, which means the earnings announcement is happening today or has just happened. Resolution is essentially immediate - likely within hours.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provides very specific forward guidance information:
- NVIDIA issued Q2 FY2027 guidance in May 2026: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (range: $89.2B to $92.8B)
- Wall Street consensus for Q2: ~$91.9 billion
- **UBS guidance for Q3 FY2027: $107-108 billion**

The question asks specifically about "forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release" - this is asking what NVIDIA will **guide for Q3 FY2027** when they report Q2 FY2027 results today.

The research clearly states: "analysts suggest that the forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 will be the more crucial factor for the market."

UBS is reportedly telling clients to expect Q3 guidance of $107-108 billion. This is the most concrete forward-looking guidance estimate provided in the research.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker than expected demand in data center or AI markets
- Geopolitical developments further restricting China sales (current guidance already excludes China revenue)
- Supply chain constraints or production delays
- Macro deterioration affecting customer capex spending
- Conservative management guidance in light of recent volatility

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better than expected Q2 results leading to raised guidance
- Stronger than anticipated AI chip demand continuing
- Potential approval or revenue from China data center sales (explicitly excluded from current guidance)
- Accelerating adoption of newer architectures (Blackwell, etc.)
- Market share gains from competitors
- Higher than consensus estimate from Wall Street

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides specific prior guidance:
- Q2 FY2027 guidance issued in May 2026: $91.0B ± 2%
- Wall Street consensus: $91.9B
- **UBS Q3 FY2027 guidance expectation: $107-108B**

NVIDIA historically provides guidance at the time of earnings release for the subsequent quarter. The UBS estimate of $107-108B appears to be the market's best current estimate based on analyst conversations.

---

## Probability Distribution

The range provided is 99.5B to 115.5B. The UBS estimate of $107-108B falls comfortably within this range and represents the best available forward-looking guidance estimate from the research.

Given:
1. UBS provides a specific $107-108B estimate
2. This is the most recent analyst view on what NVIDIA will guide
3. The question is asking about guidance being issued today
4. The range appears calibrated around this expected level

The distribution should be centered around $107-108 billion with reasonable dispersion around it.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is set to report its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after the U.S. market close, with the analyst call following at 2 p.m. PT [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026). While the Q2 print will be released, analysts suggest that the forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 will be the more crucial factor for the market [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825).

NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 revenue guidance, issued in May 2026, was approximately $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% (a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion) [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This guidance explicitly excludes any data center compute revenue from China, meaning any approved China sales would represent upside [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026). Wall Street consensus for Q2 revenue is slightly higher, at around $91.9 billion [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). UBS is reportedly telling clients to expect NVIDIA to guide Q3 revenue to $107-108 billion [aliteq.com](https://aliteq.com/nvidia-q2-fy27-earnings-preview-ubs-2026).
